scope: Bounded source-clause and named-item audit of 4.1–4.19P, visually checked on specification PDF pages 25–26 / printed 19–20. Requirement suffixes are editorial; teaching/assessment remains partial.
identifierPolicy: Requirement suffixes r1, r2, etc. are local editorial audit identifiers; only the parent reference is publisher-numbered.

parents.scopeNote: All eight named units remain separate local requirements.

requirements.summary: Use kilograms appropriately.
remainingChecks: Validate mass-prefix conversion across several energy equations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use joules appropriately.
remainingChecks: Distinguish energy/work from force or power and validate conversions.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use metres appropriately.
remainingChecks: Validate vertical height versus distance along a force.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use metres per second appropriately.
remainingChecks: Check speed-unit conversion before squaring speed.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use metres per second squared appropriately.
remainingChecks: Check acceleration and gravitational-field unit interpretation independently.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use newtons appropriately.
remainingChecks: Distinguish force from mass in work calculations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use seconds appropriately.
remainingChecks: Validate minutes-to-seconds conversion in power calculations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use watts appropriately.
remainingChecks: Distinguish transfer rate from energy and validate kW conversion.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Eight named stores and four named transfer pathways are tracked; local subdivisions do not create publisher subnumbers.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the chemical store.
remainingChecks: Assess an unfamiliar fuel or battery system with named initial/final stores.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the kinetic store.
remainingChecks: Assess motion changes with both useful and dissipative transfers.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the gravitational store.
remainingChecks: Validate a system boundary that includes the gravitational interaction.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the elastic store.
remainingChecks: Assess loading and release, not merely the name of a spring.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the thermal store.
remainingChecks: Distinguish stored internal energy from a heating pathway.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the magnetic store.
remainingChecks: Validate a work/interaction example with attractive as well as repulsive poles.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the electrostatic store.
remainingChecks: Validate a work/interaction example without confusing charge with energy.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe transfers involving the nuclear store.
remainingChecks: Assess the distinction between nuclear release and chemical combustion.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe energy transferred mechanically.
remainingChecks: Validate force/displacement links across spring, motion and lifting examples.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe energy transferred electrically.
remainingChecks: Assess a circuit transfer without inventing an electrical store.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe energy transferred by heating.
remainingChecks: Assess a thermal transfer without treating heat as a stored substance.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe energy transferred by radiation, including light and sound.
remainingChecks: Validate both source examples while preserving sound’s need for a medium.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Conservation is a use requirement, not only a memorised statement.

requirements.summary: Apply conservation of energy to a defined system.
remainingChecks: Validate non-zero initial stores, external work and dissipative transfers.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The official denominator is total energy output; equality with input needs an appropriate steady-device balance.

requirements.summary: Know the useful-output / total-output efficiency relationship.
remainingChecks: Validate recall and fraction-versus-percentage notation.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use the efficiency relationship.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse input/output targets and cases with changing stored energy.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: A range of devices and Sankey representations are both explicitly included.

requirements.summary: Explain device energy transfers using useful/total output and efficiency.
remainingChecks: Assess unfamiliar purposes so that useful output is not assigned by rote.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Represent and interpret transfers with Sankey diagrams.
remainingChecks: Validate learner-drawn proportional widths and more than two outputs.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: All three named mechanisms must be distinguished.

requirements.summary: Describe conduction.
remainingChecks: Validate particle/electron explanations without bulk particle flow in solids.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe convection.
remainingChecks: Assess density-driven bulk fluid circulation and its limits.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe radiation transfer.
remainingChecks: Validate electromagnetic transfer across a vacuum and simultaneous pathways.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Everyday phenomena are required, not just a lab description.

requirements.summary: Explain convection in everyday situations.
remainingChecks: Add independently assessed room-heating/cooling circulation scenarios.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Both absorption/emission and surface/temperature effects are explicit.

requirements.summary: Explain how surface finish affects absorption and emission.
remainingChecks: Validate fair-comparison conditions and distinguish absorption from emission.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Explain how temperature relates to radiation transfer.
remainingChecks: Assess hotter same-surface emission and equilibrium with continuing exchange.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The practical explicitly covers conduction, convection and radiation.

requirements.summary: Investigate conduction experimentally.
remainingChecks: Validate a results task with geometry, heat capacity and loss limitations.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Investigate convection experimentally.
remainingChecks: Assess tracer circulation against stirring and diffusion alternatives.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Investigate radiation transfer experimentally.
remainingChecks: Validate absorption and emission investigations separately; the existing practical is absorption.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Insulation is an illustrative method, not the only permitted way to reduce unwanted transfer.

requirements.summary: Explain methods of reducing unwanted energy transfer.
remainingChecks: Assess mechanisms in unfamiliar insulation and mechanical-friction contexts.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Know/use local subdivisions retain the direction-of-force condition.

requirements.summary: Know work = force × distance along the force.
remainingChecks: Validate equation recall and displacement direction.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use W = Fd.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse quantities and work by individual versus resultant forces.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Work and energy transfer are linked explicitly.

requirements.summary: Recognise work done as energy transferred.
remainingChecks: Assess constant-speed examples where individual work is non-zero.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Near-surface gravitational energy uses vertical height and the stated g.

requirements.summary: Know gravitational potential energy = mgh.
remainingChecks: Validate symbols, reference level and unit choice.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use gravitational potential energy = mgh.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse targets and distinguish vertical rise from path length.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Know/use local subdivisions preserve squared-speed dependence.

requirements.summary: Know kinetic energy = ½mv².
remainingChecks: Validate independent recall and proportional reasoning.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Use kinetic energy = ½mv².
remainingChecks: Calibrate square-root targets, mass conversion and realistic domains.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The required link includes gravitational, kinetic and work terms.

requirements.summary: Use conservation to link gravitational and kinetic energy with work.
remainingChecks: Validate varied initial/final motion and dissipative work without assuming mgh always equals final KE.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Rate of energy transfer and rate of doing work describe the same power concept.

requirements.summary: Describe power as a transfer/work rate.
remainingChecks: Assess equal-energy/different-time and equal-time/different-energy comparisons.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: The source requires use of power, work and time relationship.

requirements.summary: Use P = W/t.
remainingChecks: Calibrate inverse time/work and input-versus-useful power.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Seven source bullets are tracked. Water is one publisher bullet; hydro/tidal/wave are teaching examples.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using wind.
remainingChecks: Assess moving-air to turbine to electrical transfers without claiming the generator creates energy.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using water.
remainingChecks: Validate reservoir hydro and at least one moving-water alternative with the correct source store.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using geothermal resources.
remainingChecks: Assess hot underground fluid/rock to working fluid to generator transfers.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using solar heating systems.
remainingChecks: Distinguish solar thermal generation from domestic water heating alone.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using solar cells.
remainingChecks: Assess direct radiation-to-electrical transfer without adding a turbine.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using fossil fuels.
remainingChecks: Assess chemical store, heating, steam/turbine and electrical transfers.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe electricity generation using nuclear power.
remainingChecks: Assess nuclear release/heating and distinguish it from chemical burning.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

parents.scopeNote: Large-scale comparisons must include advantages and disadvantages for renewable and non-renewable methods.

requirements.summary: Describe advantages and disadvantages of renewable electricity resources.
remainingChecks: Calibrate scenario-linked reliability, geography, environmental effects and storage rather than generic lists.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.

requirements.summary: Describe advantages and disadvantages of non-renewable electricity resources.
remainingChecks: Calibrate fossil/nuclear comparisons and operational versus wider lifecycle effects.
Independent assessment-family coverage is not yet validated.
